ledger: Man | Center frame, facing camera | Left side, facing left profile | Turns body to left and approaches door
Wooden double doors | Behind man, central background | Behind man and to his right | Camera cuts to side profile
Wall clock | Upper center background on door | Upper background behind man | Remains on door, but relative position to coat changes
Blue coat | Hanging on wall left of center | Hanging on wall right of center | Swaps sides relative to clock

findings.description: In the initial frontal shot, the blue coat hangs to the left of the wall clock. In the subsequent side-angle shot, the blue coat hangs to the right of the wall clock. The relative positions of these fixed architectural elements have inverted.
